translations.source: Lake Oil, the flagship company of the Lake Group, was established in the year 2006. Lake Oil operates as retail stations and bulk petroleum distributors. It began its expansion by commencing operations in Zambia in 2008, with currently 47 fuel stations in operation. Further, the company launched its presence in DRC under Sun Fuel SARL in 2011. By 2012, Lake Oil expanded to Burundi. In 2017, Lake Oil Ltd further expanded to Kenya. In 2020, it expanded to Mozambique as Lake Oil LDA.
translations.translation: Lake Oil, kampuni kinara ya Lake Group, ilianzishwa mwaka 2006. Lake Oil huendesha vituo vya rejareja na kusambaza mafuta ya petroli kwa wingi. Ilianza upanuzi wake kwa kuanza shughuli nchini Zambia mwaka 2008, na kwa sasa ina vituo 47 vya mafuta vinavyofanya kazi. Kisha kampuni ilianza shughuli zake nchini DRC kupitia Sun Fuel SARL mwaka 2011. Mwaka 2012, Lake Oil ilipanuka hadi Burundi. Mwaka 2017, Lake Oil Ltd ilipanuka hadi Kenya. Mwaka 2020, ilipanuka hadi Msumbiji kama Lake Oil LDA.

translations.source: Lake Oil began its expansion in Zambia in 2008 and launched operations in DR Congo under Sun Fuel SARL in 2011. The current DRC network has 7 fuel stations, with 6 currently operational. The company expanded to Burundi in 2012 and established operations in Kenya in 2017. In 2020, it expanded to Mozambique as Lake Oil LDA. Frontier Energy SARL also operates in DR Congo, while terminals operate in Tanzania, Kenya, Mozambique and Zambia.
translations.translation: Lake Oil ilianza kupanuka nchini Zambia mwaka 2008 na kuanzisha shughuli nchini DR Congo kupitia Sun Fuel SARL mwaka 2011. Mtandao wa sasa wa DRC una vituo 7 vya mafuta, ambapo 6 vinafanya kazi kwa sasa. Kampuni ilipanuka hadi Burundi mwaka 2012 na kuanzisha shughuli nchini Kenya mwaka 2017. Mwaka 2020, ilipanuka hadi Msumbiji kama Lake Oil LDA. Frontier Energy SARL pia hufanya kazi nchini DR Congo, huku vituo vya kuhifadhia vikifanya kazi Tanzania, Kenya, Msumbiji na Zambia.
